summary: The figure shows total excess deaths by WHO region from 1 January 2020 to 31 December 2021, divided into reported COVID-19 deaths and excess deaths not captured in reported COVID-19 deaths. The South-East Asia Region has the highest total excess deaths, followed by the Region of the Americas and the European Region. The Western Pacific Region has the lowest total excess deaths. Excess deaths not captured in reported COVID-19 deaths constitute a significant portion of total excess deaths in most regions.
